import pytest
from calendar_core import parse_event
from calendar_core.slots import Event, overlaps, free_slots, fmt_duration


def test_issue_24h_with_title():
    """Format "<start>-<end> <title>", e.g. "09:30-10:15 Standup"."""
    ev = parse_event("09:30-10:15 Standup")
    assert ev.start == 570  # 9*60+30 = 570
    assert ev.end == 615  # 10*60+15 = 615
    assert ev.title == "Standup"


def test_issue_12h_spaces_around_dash():
    """Spaces around '-' are allowed with 12-hour times like "9am - 10:30am Design review"."""
    ev = parse_event("9am - 10:30am Design review")
    assert ev.start == 540  # 9*60 = 540
    assert ev.end == 630  # 10*60+30 = 630
    assert ev.title == "Design review"


def test_issue_empty_title():
    """The title may be empty, e.g. "2pm-3pm"."""
    ev = parse_event("2pm-3pm")
    assert ev.start == 840  # 14*60 = 840
    assert ev.end == 900  # 15*60 = 900
    assert ev.title == ""


def test_issue_title_surrounding_spaces_removed():
    """The title is the rest of the text with surrounding spaces removed."""
    ev = parse_event("09:30-10:15   Standup   ")
    assert ev.start == 570  # 9*60+30 = 570
    assert ev.end == 615  # 10*60+15 = 615
    assert ev.title == "Standup"


def test_issue_title_containing_dash_kept():
    """The title is the rest of the text after "<start>-<end>"."""
    ev = parse_event("09:00-10:00 Stand-up follow-up")
    assert ev.start == 540  # 9*60 = 540
    assert ev.end == 600  # 10*60 = 600
    assert ev.title == "Stand-up follow-up"


def test_issue_missing_dash_raises():
    """Raise ValueError if the dash is missing."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_event("09:30 10:15 Standup")


def test_issue_invalid_time_raises():
    """Raise ValueError if a time is invalid."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_event("25:00-26:00 Oops")


def test_issue_end_before_start_raises():
    """Raise ValueError if the end is not after the start."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_event("10:15-09:30 Backwards")


def test_issue_end_equal_start_raises():
    """Raise ValueError if the end is not after the start (equal times)."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_event("09:30-09:30 Zero")


def test_contract_back_to_back_no_overlap():
    """Back-to-back events (one ends exactly when the next starts) do not overlap."""
    a = Event(540, 600)  # 9*60 = 540, 10*60 = 600
    b = Event(600, 660)  # 10*60 = 600, 11*60 = 660
    assert overlaps(a, b) is False


def test_contract_free_slots_gap():
    """free_slots returns the gaps inside [day_start, day_end) not covered by any event."""
    events = [Event(540, 600)]  # 9*60 = 540, 10*60 = 600
    assert free_slots(events, 540, 660, 1) == [(600, 660)]  # 10*60 = 600, 11*60 = 660


def test_contract_fmt_duration_render():
    """fmt_duration renders "Xh YYm" (e.g. 65 -> "1h 05m")."""
    assert fmt_duration(65) == "1h 05m"  # 65 = 1*60+5
